core_obligations: Choose a presentation diagram with U, V schemes and surjective etale vertical arrows (proof lines 7086-7095).
Use the definitions of local quasi-finiteness and of relative dimension for algebraic spaces to translate both conditions to h : U -> V (proof lines 7096-7099).
Apply the scheme case to h and read the equivalence back for f (proof lines 7100-7101).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: a locally of finite type morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over S is locally quasi-finite if and only if it has relative dimension 0 at every x in |X| (source lines 7076-7083). The proof chooses a presentation diagram with U, V schemes and surjective etale vertical arrows, and uses the definitions to see that h : U -> V is locally quasi-finite exactly when f is and that h has relative dimension 0 at all points of U exactly when f does at all points of |X|; the claim then follows from the corresponding scheme statement.
